Grand Battery.name: Grand Battery
Grand Battery.description: The user's signature move: they spend their reserves at once on a ring of loaded cannons that pour from their back and arms and turn on every enemy in sight. Each enemy takes massive bludgeoning damage and is knocked flat, or takes a net round instead and stays pinned to the ground until they tear free with a hard effort or are cut loose; afterward the user cannot make anything until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
